operators.description:
This dictionary defines the OpenShift operator configuration settings.

Required fields are:
  * `operators_to_install`

Optional fields are:
  * `cilium`
  * `gitea`
  * `nvidia_gpu_operator`
  * `nvidia_network_operator`
  * `openshift_gitops`
  * `portworx`
  * `redhat_ods_operator`

operators_to_install.description:
List of operators to install on the OpenShift cluster.  Supported operators include:
  * `aap` - Ansible Automation Platform
  * `cert-manager-operator` - cert-manager Operator for Red Hat OpenShift
  * `cisco-intersight` - Cisco Intersight Operator
  * `external-secrets-operator` - External Secrets Operator for Red Hat OpenShift
  * `nvidia-gpu-operator` - NVIDIA GPU Operator
  * `nvidia-network-operator` - NVIDIA Network Operator
  * `openshift-cnv` - OpenShift Virtualization
  * `openshift-nmstate` - Kubernetes NMState Operator
  * `openshift-nfd` - Node Feature Discovery Operator
  * `openshift-sriov-network-operator` - SR-IOV Network Operator
  * `redhat-ods-operator` - Red Hat OpenShift AI

Notes:

The following will automatically be installed:

  * `lldpd` - The LLDPD DaemonSet for Network Discovery

The `openshift_gitops` operator is automatically installed if `operators_to_install` includes any operators.

The `openshift-ods-operator` (AKA Red Hat OpenShift AI) will also install the following operators:

  * `cert-manager-operator` - cert-manager Operator for Red Hat OpenShift - If not already selected.
  * `nvidia-gpu-operator` - NVIDIA GPU Operator.  If not already selected.
  * `nvidia-network-operator` - NVIDIA Network Operator.  If not already selected.
  * `openshift-cluster-observability-operator` - Cluster Observability Operator.
  * `openshift-connectivity-link` - Red Hat Connectivity Link.  The Authorino, DNS, and Limitador Operators are automatically installed as dependencies of the Red Hat Connectivity Link Operator.
  * `openshift-jobset-operator` - Job Set Operator.  Unless `redhat_ods_operator`: `enable_distributed_workloads` is set to `false`.
  * `openshift-keda` - Custom Metrics Autoscaler
  * `openshift-kmm` - Kernel Module Management
  * `openshift-kueue-operator` - Red Hat build of Kueue.  Unless `redhat_ods_operator`: `enable_distributed_workloads` is set to `false`.
  * `openshift-lws-operator` - Red Hat build of Leader Worker Set
  * `openshift-nfd` - Node Feature Discovery Operator.  If not already selected.
  * `openshift-opentelemetry-operator` - Red Hat build of OpenTelemetry
  * `openshift-sriov-network-operator` - SR-IOV Network Operator.  If not already selected.
  * `openshift-tempo-operator` - Tempo Operator
